endpoint: All measured second-column current coordinates treated as conditional on the matching first-column measured voltage. No voltage-grid/endpoints/counts of the 28 target sweeps enter the predictions. Each prelocked affine I(V) is evaluated by the receiver at each native single row. Secondary maximum measured power, from VI, is derivative of the same electrical data; no calorimetric success claim. All methods receive the same per-row ordinal and voltage budget. Only elapsed_shape uses ordinal. The original measurements have neither absolute time nor load-reversal records. A predictive difference between the ordinal- and V/E-indexed forms does not establish that either is a physical transient.
grouping: Actual report per 28 complete sweeps, 7 nominal gradients per held module, 4 distinct test devices on one apparatus. Equal row weights within sweep, equal sweep within device, then equal device. Joint gate candidate strictly lower complete current RMSE and MAE than every comparator and strictly lower RMSE on at least 3 of 4 modules against each.
assumptions: Face-sensor controller setpoints d=10..90 C and cold=20C. The first development file is headerless with two numeric columns and decimal comma; first increments cluster around the declared 5 mV step, including negative initial measured V, and second decreases toward zero on the measured open-circuit stop. Source thesis measures voltage and current, first column V, second current in SI assumed subject to calibration qualification. Native per-row thermometer, actuator command, heater flux, sweep time, contact/leg and material temperature are not asserted. File order j maps to d=10*j according to study measure number. The already exposed 2.97% figure and N/Z constants are outside the targets.
fit: For each of 44 source curves compute OLS current on measured voltage; E=-offset/slope, R=-1/slope. Module anchors are mean(E/d) and mean(R) from its two low nominal gradients; x=d-15. Donor modules 1..4 at all d determine common normalized E/d and R versus x. Candidate uses unit-intercept first-order least squares in x and those module anchors, plus one common dimensionless correction to 1-V/E, obtained by equal-curve averaging donor residual I*R/E-(1-V/E) on a fixed 47-point recovered voltage grid. Linear interpolation with constant endpoint residual. This is a shared measured terminal-shape correction, not an identified mechanism or an exact quadratic transport solution. Target functions are locked as E,R and shape table, with no target contacts or file lengths. Integrated_line drops correction. Elapsed_shape substitutes a separately trained source residual against current row number, wavelengths and acquisition time are unavailable. Constant_thevenin keeps anchor R and E/d. Source_mean_curve uses unadjusted mean donor E,R at the same d with same-donor/d shape. Relative_by_setting uses exact same-donor/same-d mean multiplicative factor on source anchors and an ideal line; relative_by_setting_shape applies the same-d donor shape. Additive_by_setting instead transports additive changes and applies same-d shape. Local_gradient extrapolates per-module log slope based only on its two measured settings; shrunk_local averages global and local log trajectories equally. Quadratic_shared solves unit-intercept least squares in x,x² for E/d and R and uses common shape. Nearest_corrected chooses donor nearest source anchor in unweighted Euclidean coordinates log(E/d),log(R), uses its same-d relative scale and shape. Wrong_module assigns cyclically other target anchors with unchanged shared model. Refuse whole source course if any predicted E/R is nonpositive. All curves tested at all native voltage rows without clipping model output. Physical shape assumptions and log extrapolation bases fixed before held arrays.
convention: OLS current-coordinate units reflect the reported SI voltage/current acquisition; headerless text carries no independently authenticated per-file units or per-row temperatures, so score labeling retains native current-coordinate units. Nominal gradient j labels from source instrument methods. Every dev sweep had strictly increasing first coordinate; all 44 start at negative measured voltage, and largest per-run source fit RMSE .04142 native current. Source values may separate settings/initial points but not current-dependent nonlinearity from chronology under one sweep ordering.
normalized_grid: 47 fixed coordinates q=-0.10+0.025i, i=0..46. Source normalized residuals are interpolated then held constant beyond each curve’s measured extremes. Source ordinal knots [0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512,768,1024,1536]; omit a knot only if no donor ever reaches that ordinal. Interpolate across retained knots. Source_mean/same-setting and nearest use matched donor setting template(s); polynomial/local/shrink/wrong rely on pooled template. No held support mask or unmeasured temperature is passed.
score: Every reported model scored on all 28 voltage/current sweeps. For each compute RMSE, MAE, signed bias, maximum absolute native current error, and maximum power over the measured grid as secondary with coordinate V,I and stopping selection explicit. Per-module and overall equal weights; diagnostic split initial 16 rows vs rest, and landmark near V=0. No pointwise resampling confidence claim. Write full native sample census/readback pins and worst row plus ±5 neighbors with every aligned forecast. The reference computes all residuals directly from locked functions and original public files.
